description_sq:
Disponojme vile per shitje me vendodhje ne Farke. Vendndodhje fantastike, vetem 600 meter larg me autostraden e Tegut(prane daljes se surrelit) ofron qetesi, privatesi dhe nje pamje panoramike nga liqeni i Farkes. Ky kompleks shtrihet ne nje territor prej 6500 m2 truall i ndare ne 10 vila. Tipologjite e vilave qe ndodhen jane vilat e mesme dhe vilat e medha. Vilat e medha shtrihen ne vijen e pare me pamje totale nga liqeni dhe vilat mesatare me pamje po prap nga liqeni por me te reduktuar. Vila ka nje siperfaqe parcele prej 442 m2 dhe nje siperfaqe banimi prej 341.8 m2, verande 57 m2, pishine dhe jacuzzi 32 m2 si edhe 40 m2 siperfaqe per 2 poste parkimi. Vila ka strukture 2 kateshe. Kati -1, me siperfaqe 105.6 m2 organizohet nga depo dhe dhome lavanderie. Kati perdhe me siperfaqe 88.9 m2 organizohet nga ambienti i gatimit, salloni i ndenjes i cili me ane te nje vetrate 3.8 m ka akses te menjehershem tek pishina dhe jacuzzi, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet me dritare. Kati 1, me siperfaqe 90.3 m2 organizohet nga 2 dhoma gjumi, garderobe, 2 tualete dhe verande. Residenca ofron vila me dizajn shume te vecante dhe ofron 8 meter lartesi ne objekt: ndare ne katin nentoke 3 meter lartesi me drita natyrale (goje ujku), kati perdhe me lartesi 5 meter (i vetmi kompleks qe e ofron) dhe kati 1 me lartesi 3 m. Veshja e vilave do jete me sistem kapot dhe rifinituarat do jene me veshje pllake si ne render ose material cimentato ne dukje si beton facavista. Kompleksi ne faze themelesh dhe perfundimi dhjetor 2024. Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni.
 PRO+34290
description_en: We have villas for sale located in Farke. Fantastic location, only 600 meters away from the Tegut highway (near the Surrel exit) offers peace, privacy and a panoramic view of the Farka lake. This complex is spread over a territory of 6500 m2 of land divided into 10 villas. The types of villas that are located are medium villas and large villas. The large villas are located on the first line with a total view of the lake and the medium villas with a view back of the lake but with a reduced view. The villa has a plot area of ​​442 m2 and a living area of ​​341.8 m2, veranda 57 m2, swimming pool and jacuzzi 32 m2 as well as 40 m2 surface for 2 parking spaces. The villa has a 2-story structure. Floor -1, with an area of ​​105.6 m2, is organized by a storage room and a laundry room. The ground floor with an area of ​​88.9 m2 is organized by the kitchen, the living room, which through a 3.8 m window has immediate access to the pool and jacuzzi, a bedroom, a bathroom with a window. The 1st floor, with an area of ​​90.3 m2, is organized by 2 bedrooms, wardrobe, 2 toilets and a veranda. The residence offers villas with a very special design and offers 8 meters of height in the building: basement 3 meters high with natural light (wolf's mouth), ground floor with a height of 5 meters (the only complex that offers it) and 1st floor with a height of 3 meters. The cladding of the villas will be with the kapot system and the refinished ones will be covered with tiles as in render or cement material that looks like facavista concrete. The complex is in the foundation phase and will be completed in December 2024. For more information, contact us. PRO+34290
